title: Pipeline
description: A pipeline's own declaration: src/main/<pipeline>/pipeline.json. Its DIRECTORY is the pipeline name, so the name is not a field here — and a directory cannot hold two entries of one name, which is how uniqueness stops being a check. The filename is uniform (pipeline.json, the kind, not the instance): cli/'s <noun>.json convention marks the bare command's declaration among its verb files, a role that does not exist inside a pipeline directory, and three siblings should share one shape down to the filename. This schema lives beside what it describes rather than under rsc/schema/, which is the data domain: the pipeline declaration is this repo's own interface, not corpus data. Derivables are absent by construction: the remedy command is `corpus-yoga pipeline run <name>`, the format history is rsc/schema/<name>/<schemas[0]>/CHANGELOG.md, and the cache root comes from rsc/cache_io.csv — each a function of the name, so declaring them could only contradict the derivation.

schemas.description: The schema families this pipeline's data validates against, each by its address under rsc/schema/<pipeline>/ - <provider>/<family> where the family's instances are one provider's, <family> otherwise (issues/632) - so that two providers' families of one name are two entries. Order is load-bearing: the FIRST entry is the schema whose CHANGELOG.md anchors the pipeline's format history.

input.description: The repo-relative directory under data/input/ the pipeline reads. The one committed authority for this path: run.sh reads it from here rather than restating it. A literal <provider> segment stands for each provider the `provider` member names, one store each (issues/635). A literal <qualifier> segment stands for each provider's declared qualifier.

input_glob.description: The glob under input that selects one datum. A trailing slash selects directories; no trailing slash selects files.

provider.description: The providers the pipeline reads, each a row of rsc/provider/providers.csv with a mechanism directory of its name beside the declaration, and each with the globs that select its data under its own store: a provider writes a session as its harness does, a file or a directory. Present exactly when input carries <provider>; each store's cache is its input address under cache/pipeline, the provider a segment of it.

input_glob.description: The glob under this provider's input that selects one datum.

extra_input_glob.description: A second input shape beyond input_glob, at the same subject depth. Empty when the provider has one shape.

qualifier.description: What <qualifier> in input stands for under this provider's store - the capture directory's qualifier, API or DOM. Present exactly when input carries <qualifier>.

measure.description: How a unit input_glob selects is related to the held one of its address at promotion, a row of src/main/corpus.py's MEASURE (issues/687): prefix - the bytes of each selected file, each by prefix; message-uuids - the set of message uuids of <unit>/<unit>.json, by inclusion; turn-extent - (human turns, total turns) of the unit's markdown, componentwise; mirror - a mirror of a single-writer source, identical or replaced whole; whole - held whole or not at all.

extra_measure.description: The measure of a unit extra_input_glob selects, as measure. Empty exactly when extra_input_glob is.

unit.description: What one thing input_glob selects is called, in the singular - the word a count of them is given under (issues/736).

families.description: The families, each an entry of schemas, that judge a unit input_glob selects: the validate step validates the unit's data against each, the rehearsal keys its verdicts by them, and the stage judges the unit by them - one home for the pairing of a unit kind to its judges (issues/1018). Empty where no family judges the kind, and the unit promotes on its relation alone.

extra_unit.description: What one thing extra_input_glob selects is called. Empty exactly when extra_input_glob is.

extra_families.description: The families that judge a unit extra_input_glob selects, as families does for input_glob. Empty when extra_input_glob is, and where no family judges the kind.

companion.description: A path beside what input_glob selects, <stem> standing for the stem of a selected file: it moves with that file and the file is the unit - claude's workspace <stem>/ beside <stem>.jsonl. Empty where a unit's files lie within it.

record.description: A file within each unit input_glob selects, recording what its capture was to fetch: where it stands, the unit is complete only when it holds every member the record lists, by rsc/naming/export_archive_members.csv; where it does not - a unit from before its capture kept one - the unit reads complete. It moves with the unit, as every file within it does: the bulk export's manifest.json within data-<X>/. Empty where a capture keeps no record.

subject_depth.description: How many path components under a store's cache root - its input address under cache/pipeline - name one subject.

extra_input_glob.description: A second input shape the pipeline demands beyond input_glob, at the same subject depth; the trailing-slash convention is per glob. Empty when the pipeline has one shape.

measure.description: How a unit input_glob selects is related to the held one of its address at promotion, a row of src/main/corpus.py's MEASURE (issues/687): prefix - the bytes of each selected file, each by prefix; message-uuids - the set of message uuids of <unit>/<unit>.json, by inclusion; turn-extent - (human turns, total turns) of the unit's markdown, componentwise; mirror - a mirror of a single-writer source, identical or replaced whole; whole - held whole or not at all.

extra_measure.description: The measure of a unit extra_input_glob selects, as measure. Empty exactly when extra_input_glob is.

unit.description: What one thing input_glob selects is called, in the singular - the word a count of them is given under (issues/736): a capture, an export, a session.

Empty where no family judges the kind, and the unit promotes on its relation alone.

diagnostic_skip.description: Diagnostics to skip beyond the universal versioned-schema skip set, by the family that deviates: each key one of `schemas`, each value the diagnostics that family is licensed to fail, named for the deviation. A skip belongs to the family that needs it, so a family declared beside it loses no check. Empty when no family deviates.
